title: Choose Filesmith's visual world
question: New hand: the roll dealt the Bag Sizer. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bag Sizer
options.lineage: airport cabin-bag sizers and terminal wayfinding
options.thesis: Every file is checked against its limit like hand luggage in the sizer: it fits, or Filesmith makes it fit.
materials: black rail with yellow wayfinding bands
options.viewport: Black rail where yellow marks only where you are, the size limit set monumental like a gate number, and every file row showing its bar against the sizer frame.
options.risk: Yellow must stay reserved for wayfinding; spread around it turns into a hazard-tape costume.

raised.raise: Yellow means 'you are here' and nothing else; one message per line.
Trim and GIF timelines draw exact duration: bar length is real seconds.
Each tool family keeps one full-strength hue as its section colour.
State reads from line form too (solid live, dashed queued, struck failed), never colour alone.
Every claim sits next to its proof: the measured before/after, not an adjective.

options.label: Till Receipt
options.lineage: shop till receipts: itemised lines, dotted leaders, a total you saved
options.thesis: Every job ends in a receipt: what went in, what came out, and what you saved.
options.viewport: Till-blue rail, the queue as itemised lines with dotted leaders from file name to before/after size, a running total at the foot.
options.risk: Familiar: the receipt motif shows up in some finance apps.

options.label: Terminal Signage
options.thesis: The app as an overhead sign: yellow bands tell you where each job goes.
options.viewport: A yellow overhead band of tools across the top, monumental size limit, queue beneath.
options.case: Same terminal world everyone knows; loses narrowly on clarity because a yellow band everywhere shouts.
options.risk: Loud: a full yellow header is tiring on a tool used daily.

options.label: Monochrome Product Site
options.thesis: Every claim paired with its proof.
options.case: Declined: a marketing-page language, not a working screen.
options.kept: Every claim paired with its proof.

options.label: Factory Sleeve
options.thesis: One element owns the field; vast quiet space.
options.case: Declined: coded colour strips hide plain-language labels everyday users need.
options.kept: One element owns the field; vast quiet space.

options.label: Dance Score
options.case: Declined: nobody fixing a file reads dance notation.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.case: Declined: old software manuals aren't in everyday users' world.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: State as line form, not hue.
options.case: Declined: a lab instrument look; reads cold and technical.
options.kept: State as line form, not hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean utility app like the best Mac and Windows converters, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, a toolbar of tool tabs, the queue and a settings inspector.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other converters by design.
